facts.fact: The Ghana Open Data Initiative's history page lists a draft National Data Sharing (Open Data incorporated) policy as a deliverable of the portal revamp that ran from July 2018 to April 2019, and states no adoption of it.
facts.system: National Data Sharing (Open Data incorporated) policy

facts.fact: The page, undated and taken at its published date of 2026-08-29, describes the Ghana Open Data Initiative as a government platform run by the National Information Technology Agency under the Ministry of Communications, with a data catalogue portal rebooted in the 2018-2019 revamp; it ties the portal to the initiative and to the draft data sharing policy, not to an adopted open data policy.

systems.system: Ghana Open Data Initiative portal (data catalogue)
systems.owner: National Information Technology Agency (NITA), Ministry of Communications
systems.tiers: national; 154 staff from 20 MDAs trained in the revamp
